answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. By the forge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A jetty of per-task receipts records who did what, and the echo of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
